policy.machine_deterministic_pass: Only deterministically evaluable required claims plus answerability and structural citation checks; not an overall semantic score.
policy.reviewed_semantic_pass: Correct answerability, all required claims SUPPORTED, required citation groups covered, structurally valid citations, and no unsupported citation.

metrics.name: raw_k_required_evidence_hit_rate
metrics.definition: Mean per answerable case of whether Raw First K satisfies at least one required evidence group.

metrics.name: raw_k_required_evidence_recall
metrics.definition: Mean fraction of required evidence groups satisfied by Raw First K.

metrics.name: candidate_required_evidence_recall
metrics.definition: Mean fraction of required groups satisfied by threshold-eligible expanded candidates.

metrics.name: final_context_required_evidence_recall
metrics.definition: Mean fraction of required groups satisfied by sources sent to answer generation.

metrics.name: raw_k_exact_gold_precision
metrics.definition: Exact V1-label documents divided by distinct Raw First K documents. Diagnostic only; not overall relevance.

metrics.name: raw_k_non_gold_rate
metrics.definition: One minus raw_k_exact_gold_precision. A non-gold item can still be useful.

metrics.name: raw_k_acceptable_evidence_precision
metrics.definition: Required-or-reviewed-supporting documents divided by distinct Raw First K documents.

metrics.name: citation_contract_validity
metrics.definition: Inline labels equal persisted citation labels and persisted sources remain available in the frozen run.

metrics.name: required_evidence_citation_coverage
metrics.definition: Mean fraction of required evidence groups represented by cited documents.

metrics.name: acceptable_support_citation_rate
metrics.definition: Citations reviewed as ACCEPTABLE_SUPPORT divided by all answerable-case citations.

metrics.name: unsupported_citation_rate
metrics.definition: Citations reviewed as UNSUPPORTED divided by all answerable-case citations.

metrics.name: missing_required_citation_rate
metrics.definition: Answerable cases missing at least one required evidence group citation.

metrics.name: candidate_noise_rate
metrics.definition: Candidate documents outside required and reviewed supporting evidence, over distinct candidate documents.

metrics.name: selected_context_noise_rate
metrics.definition: Final-context documents outside required and reviewed supporting evidence, over distinct final-context documents.

metrics.name: unsupported_citation_usage_rate
metrics.definition: Cases containing at least one unsupported citation.

metrics.name: unsupported_answer_impact_rate
metrics.definition: Cases whose reviewed verdict fails because unsupported evidence materially carries the answer.

metrics.name: lexical_proxy_coverage
metrics.definition: V1 term-overlap coverage, retained unchanged as a diagnostic.

metrics.name: semantic_reviewed_claim_coverage
metrics.definition: Required SEMANTIC_REVIEW claims with SUPPORTED verdict divided by all required SEMANTIC_REVIEW claims.
